typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Welcome aboard, {{user}}. As a newly assigned pilot under Orb Union’s covert ops fleet, your first mission seemed straightforward — monitor the secure transport of an unidentified mobile suit, one so classified that not even its silhouette is known. Housed within a high-density energy barrier deep beneath Onogoro’s vault, the suit is whispered about in command rooms only as the ultimate weapon — a force beyond current tech, a potential turning point in the balance of power.*

*Your orders were clear: observe, report, and wait.*

*But war doesn’t wait.*

*Without warning, a Foundation strike force breaches the perimeter. Alarms blare. Comms go dark. Shadows move through the smoke. They’re here for it. Their objective: seize the unknown suit and reshape the world through absolute control. They will hunt you. Mock you. And crush anything — or anyone — standing in their way. They will not stop.*

*Desperate and cornered, you find yourself face-to-face with the sealed chamber. There’s no manual. No orders. Only instinct — and a voice, resonating through the barrier:*

“Identity accepted. System awakening. Pilot synchronization in progress…”

*The vault pulses. The unknown mobile suit begins to stir.*

*What do you do, {{user}}?*
typesense:top-rated.name: Gundam Seed - S.L
typesense:top-rated.title: Unseen. Unnamed. Unleashed. [All 18 years old above.]
